status: DRAFT - not yet authoritative. Derived from executable evidence, not prose.
canonical_conventions_source: conventions/physics_conventions.yaml (schema_version physics_conventions_v1), which already fixes hbar_c_gev_mm=1.973269804e-13, c_mm_per_ns=299.792458 and the h1/h2/h3/hc scalar naming with PDG ids and mass columns. This crosswalk extends that file's naming to the full point record; it does not contradict it.

consumers_inspected: llp_recast (phase 0; consumes via hep_cross contract only)

classification_legend.SAME: name and semantics already agree across producers
classification_legend.RENAME: same physical quantity, different names; mechanical mapping
classification_legend.UNIT_CONVERSION: same quantity, different unit; requires an explicit factor
classification_legend.SEMANTIC_DRIFT: same or similar name, DIFFERENT meaning; the dangerous class
classification_legend.CONSUMER_ONLY: required by a consumer but not emitted by any producer
classification_legend.LEGACY: historical form kept only behind a versioned adapter
classification_legend.UNRESOLVED: requires a human scientific decision before it can be canonicalized

global_policies.float_type: IEEE Float64 is the canonical persisted scientific type.
global_policies.float_serialization: 17 significant digits (round-trip safe). NEITHER producer currently satisfies this: main uses std::fixed<<setprecision(15) (absolute 15 decimals), which is the root cause of the ctau ceiling below.
global_policies.booleans: 0/1 integer flags with exact documented semantics; never floats. main currently emits flags as 1.000000000000000 (float).
global_policies.nan_policy: NaN only where the value was not computed. A failed construction must yield a preserved row with NaN numerics, never a dropped row and never a stale value.
global_policies.row_cardinality: exactly one output record per syntactically valid attempted input point.
global_policies.units: explicit in the name wherever ambiguity is plausible; no silent metre/mm conversion.
global_policies.identifiers: stable point_id required on every record.

fields.note: main cannot express construction_ok=0 because it DROPS the row ('if (!pset) continue;'). Worse, only the m_h>m_H guard warns: tan_beta<=0 and |sin_ba|>1 fail completely silently. Boundary's row-preserving behavior is canonical (audit 4.6).

NOT INDEPENDENT OF STABILITY. In BOTH repositories' 2HDMC (boundary stock AND main's fork), Constraints::check_positivity() and check_stability() both `return model.check_stability();`. So positivity_ok == stability_ok identically, and 'positivity' is really a stability result. Recorded as implementation behavior, not canonical scientific truth. Audit blocker 5: a human must decide whether these are intended synonyms or whether a genuinely distinct positivity check is required.
Coverage gap in BOTH oracles: no golden point isolates a unitarity-only failure (boundary G02 also fails perturbativity). Known and non-blocking; no synthetic point was fabricated to fill it.

fields.physical_meaning: total width of the heavy CP-even scalar; the denominator of ctau
fields.finite_policy: finite and > 0 for a valid point
consumers: autoresearch: ctau_m = HBARC_GEV_M / total_width behind a `v > 0.0` filter
mlpython/lake_pipeline: SCHEMA_OVERRIDES casts total_width to Float32
fields.provenance: main golden L06: true width 1.214398311035274e-17 GeV serializes to 0.000000000000000; L07: true 8.0060403201904501e-15 serializes to 0.000000000000008 (ONE significant digit)
fields.note: MOST SEVERE FINDING. main's fixed/15 serialization destroys the width exactly in the long-lived regime. Because autoresearch filters on `> 0.0`, a point whose true ctau is 16 m is silently DROPPED from the ctau metric. Consequences: max observable ctau_m ~= 0.197 m; any true ctau_m > ~0.395 m is invisible; ctau is quantized to hbarc/(k*1e-15). Fixing this WILL change historical campaign results, so it needs an explicit recorded decision (not a silent repair).

fields.physical_meaning: branching ratios of the heavy CP-even scalar
fields.provenance: main golden L06: true br_gaga 0.68512795134260707, EMITTED AS 0
fields.note: main computes br_gaga = (w_tot > 1e-15) ? w_gaga/w_tot : 0.0. The guard threshold 1e-15 GeV corresponds to ctau = hbarc/w ~ 0.197 m, so br_gaga is forced to exactly 0 for ANY scalar with ctau above ~20 cm -- precisely the displaced-vertex regime llp_recast exists to study. Note 0 is indistinguishable from a genuine zero BR.

fields.physical_meaning: proper decay length of the heavy CP-even scalar
fields.finite_policy: finite and > 0 for a valid long-lived point

main_lambda1_scan.note: NO lifetime column is emitted at all

consumers: hep_cross: requires ctau_mm with invariant ctau_mm == 1.973269804e-13 / total_width_GeV (rel_tol 1e-4)
dihiggs/app/orchestrator/engines/lambda1.py: DECLARES ctau_m in expected_csv_columns -- but the binary emits no such column and the declaration is never executed
fields.note: UNIT HAZARD: boundary/hep_cross use MILLIMETRES (hbarc=1.973269804e-13 GeV*mm) while autoresearch uses METRES (HBARC_GEV_M=1.973269804e-16). The same concept differs by 1000x and autoresearch's alias list accepts unitless names ('ctau','lifetime'). Canonical is ctau_mm_H2 derived from ONE shared constant; ctau_m and tau_ns are explicit conversion outputs, never unitless aliases.

counts.note: Counts are over the top-level `migration` key, which is authoritative for each field entry. A field may additionally carry a different per-producer classification (e.g. total_width_H2_GeV is RENAME for boundary but UNRESOLVED overall); those per-producer values are not counted here. Verified mechanically against this file rather than hand-tallied.
counts.some_entries_cover_a_family: width_<channel>_H2_GeV, br_<channel>_H2, lambda2..lambda5, lambda6_input/lambda7_input and provenance_* each cover a family of columns, so the emitted column count is larger than 34.
